item.name: Admin Roles Management API
item.description:
Complete API collection for Admin Roles & Permissions Management System.

**Features:**
- Full CRUD operations for admin roles
- Role permissions management (attach, sync, detach)
- Get available permissions (admin context only)
- Get users assigned to roles
- Search & Pagination support

**Authentication:**
All endpoints require Bearer token authentication with Admin privileges.

item.name: Roles CRUD

query.description: Search by role name or display name

request.description:
Get paginated list of all admin roles.

**Query Parameters:**
- `per_page` (optional): Number of items per page (default: 15)
- `search` (optional): Search by role name or display name

**Response:** Paginated list of admin roles with user counts and creator information.

Get details of a single admin role.

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (required): Role ID

**Response:** Complete role information including permissions and user counts.

Create a new admin role with optional permissions.

**Request Body:**
- `display_name` (required, string): Human-readable role name
- `is_active` (optional, boolean): Role active status (default: true)
- `permission_ids` (optional, array): Array of permission IDs to assign

**Note:** 
- Role type is automatically set to 'admin'
- Role name (slug) is auto-generated from display_name

Update an existing admin role with optional permissions.

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (required): Role ID

**Request Body (All fields are optional):**
- `display_name` (optional, string): New role display name
- `is_active` (optional, boolean): Role active status
- `permission_ids` (optional, array): Array of permission IDs to sync (replaces all existing permissions)

**Important Notes:**
- All fields are optional - you can update any combination
- If `permission_ids` is provided, it will REPLACE all existing permissions
- Response returns the complete updated role with permissions
- Default system roles cannot be updated

Delete an admin role.

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (required): Role ID

**Note:** 
- Default system roles cannot be deleted
- Only admin type roles can be deleted through this endpoint

item.description: CRUD operations for managing admin roles

item.name: Permissions Management

request.description:
Get all available permissions for admin roles.

**Important:** This endpoint returns ONLY permissions with `context = 'admin'`. Supplier and global permissions are excluded.

**Response:** Array of permissions grouped by category.

Get all permissions assigned to a specific role.

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (required): Role ID

**Response:** Array of permissions (admin context only) assigned to the role.

Attach (add) permissions to a role without removing existing permissions.

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (required): Role ID

**Request Body:**
- `permission_ids` (required, array): Array of permission IDs to attach

**Note:** This will ADD the permissions without removing existing ones.

Sync (replace all) permissions for a role.

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (required): Role ID

**Request Body:**
- `permission_ids` (required, array): Array of permission IDs to sync

**Note:** This will REPLACE all existing permissions with the provided ones.

Detach (remove) a single permission from a role.

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (required): Role ID
- `permissionId` (required): Permission ID to remove

**Response:** Success message confirming permission removal.

item.description: Manage permissions for admin roles
